headline: Erik ten Hag 'was a piece of crap' with Man United squad - Fred
description: Former Manchester United midfielder Fred has accused ex-boss Erik ten Hag of being a 'piece of crap' when it came to squad management.

headline: Former Man City boss Roberto Mancini: Unconcerned by guilty verdict
description: Former Manchester City manager and current Italy coach Roberto Mancini says he is unconcerned about being implicated in the financial rule-breaking scandal engulfing the English club, which on Friday said it was appealing the verdict.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Man United, Chelsea monitoring Benfica defender
description: Tomás Araújo is subject to interest from Manchester United and Chelsea, while free agent Jadon Sancho is happy to wait to sign for a club. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Man City appeal guilty verdict in Premier League breaches case
description: Manchester City have confirmed the club have lodged a "comprehensive appeal" after being found guilty of breaching the Premier League's financial rules.
